design_description: A black Día de los Muertos-inspired design built around a dramatic anatomical skeleton graphic. The base is almost entirely black, allowing the white bones and vivid decorative colours to dominate. The front is the centerpiece: an oversized ribcage and spine illustration covers almost the entire torso, with a stylized anatomical heart incorporated inside the chest. The bones are predominantly white with dark internal detailing, while the heart and surrounding ornamentation introduce bright pink, turquoise, orange, yellow and green accents. Floral and ornamental motifs extend around the shoulders, sleeves and lower torso, giving the skeleton a distinctly Mexican folk-art character rather than a purely anatomical look. The back is intentionally cleaner for readability. The upper section carries a large white player name and number in a distressed, gothic-style typeface, strongly contrasting with the black base. At the lower back sits a large decorated sugar skull surrounded by symmetrical flowers and colourful flourishes, visually balancing the elaborate front artwork. Small multicolour ornamental details continue around the sleeve cuffs and shoulder line, tying the entire shirt together. Overall, it is a high-impact black skeleton and sugar-skull concept, combining anatomical imagery with Día de los Muertos floral ornamentation. The contrast is deliberately extreme: black foundation, white skeletal structure, then concentrated bursts of saturated colour used as decorative highlights.
